places: note - Malabo is on the island of Bioko

fields.terrain: coastal plains rise to interior hills; islands are volcanic
fields.hazards: violent windstorms; flash floods; volcanism: Santa Isabel (3,007 m), which last erupted in 1923, is the country's only historically active volcano; Santa Isabel and two dormant volcanoes form Bioko Island in the Gulf of Guinea
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, timber, gold, bauxite, diamonds, tantalum, sand and gravel, clay
fields.farm: sweet potatoes, cassava, plantains, oil palm fruit, root vegetables, bananas, coconuts, coffee, cocoa beans, chicken
fields.exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, alcohols, wood, scrap iron
fields.languages: Spanish (official) 67.6%, other (includes Fang, Bubi, Portuguese (official), French (official), Fa d'Ambo spoken in Annobon) 32.4%
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 88%, Protestant 5%, Muslim 2%, other 5% (animist, Baha'i, Jewish)
fields.legal: mixed system of civil and customary law
fields.military: 18-25 for voluntary military service; selective compulsory military service for men; 24-month service obligation
